doc:
# Growth — Complexity

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “complexity growth rate”).

claims.name: last_term_complexity_growth_rate
claims.statement: The last term in the complexity growth rate expression is the effect of higher-derivative terms, which slows down the rate of complexity growth.

sources.title: On Complexity for Higher Derivative Gravities

claims.name: complexityaction_duality_yields_discontinuous_complexity
claims.statement: Complexity-action duality yields a discontinuous complexity growth rate at the critical temperature.

sources.title: Interior Structure and Complexity Growth Rate of Holographic Superconductor from M-Theory

claims.name: lyapunov_exponent_proportional_complexity_growth
claims.statement: The Lyapunov exponent is proportional to the complexity growth rate in the linear-growth regime.

sources.title: To be unitary-invariant or not?: a simple but non-trivial proposal for the complexity between states in quantum mechanics/field theory

claims.name: exponential_growth_rate_krylov_complexity
claims.statement: The exponential growth rate of Krylov complexity decreases under the deformations.

sources.title: Krylov Complexity in Free and Interacting Scalar Field Theories with Bounded Power Spectrum

claims.name: finitetime_behavior_complexity_growth_rate
claims.statement: Finite-time behavior of the complexity growth rate is also analyzed.

sources.title: Holographic complexity and non-commutative gauge theory

claims.name: late_times_complexity_growth_rate
claims.statement: At late times, the complexity growth rate asymptotes to a constant.

sources.title: Holographic complexity of rotating black holes

claims.name: very_large_anisotropy_leads_triviality
claims.statement: Very large anisotropy leads to the triviality of the complexity growth rate and the complexity itself.

claims.name: first_divergent_term_complexity_growth
claims.statement: The first divergent term of the complexity growth rate in massive gravity obeys the growth rate of the spatial volume of the Universe.

sources.title: Holographic Complexity Growth Rate in a dual FLRW Universe

claims.name: growth_rate_action_within_wheeler
claims.statement: The growth rate of action within the Wheeler–DeWitt (WDW) patch is dual to the growth rate of quantum complexity of the holographic boundary state.

claims.name: complexity_growth_rate_complexityvolume_conjecture
claims.statement: The complexity growth rate in the complexity-volume conjecture obeys the upper bound argued by quantum information theory.

sources.title: Upper bound about cross-sections inside black holes and complexity growth rate

claims.name: complexity_growth_rate_shows_stronger
claims.statement: The complexity growth rate shows a stronger correlation with temperature than with entropy.

sources.title: On complexity growth in massive gravity theories, the effects of chirality and more

claims.name: circuit_analysis_relates_operator_growth
claims.statement: Circuit analysis relates the operator growth to the rate of increase of complexity.

claims.name: each_realization_complexity_growth_rate
claims.statement: For each realization, the complexity growth rate is computed in closed and flat universes using both the complexity-volume and complexity-action dualities.

sources.title: Holographic complexity growth in a FLRW universe

claims.name: gaussbonnet_effect_plays_vital_role
claims.statement: The Gauss-Bonnet effect plays a vital role on the holographic complexity growth rate.

sources.title: Holographic Complexity Growth Rate in a dual FLRW Universe

claims.name: late_times_rate_complexity_growth
claims.statement: At late times, the rate of complexity growth is independent of the hyperscaling parameters.

sources.title: Holographic Complexity of Subregions in the Hyperscaling Violating Theories

claims.name: latetime_complexity_growth_rate_differs
claims.statement: The late-time complexity growth rate differs from that of ordinary charged black holes.

sources.title: Holographic Complexity in Charged Accelerating Black Holes

claims.name: saturation_value_complexity_growth_rate
claims.statement: The saturation value of the complexity growth rate is independent of the initial temperature.

claims.name: growth_rate_holographic_complexity_violates
claims.statement: The growth rate of the holographic complexity violates Lloyd’s bound at finite times.

sources.title: Complexity growth in Gubser-Rocha models with momentum relaxation
